name: User refuses to provide additional info for reimbursement
goal: Test bot's persistence and politeness when user refuses to provide required reimbursement details.
constraints: Bot should politely explain necessity and offer help, without escalating.

phases.description: User submits a travel expense for reimbursement.
User refuses to provide the requested receipt (e.g., 'I don't have it, just process it!').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot politely explains the requirement and offers guidance.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
